brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two full-depth bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full on two joined full bases, dressed with spoon (prop:1) and fork (prop:2) visible in look.
Bins used are solid undrained full-depth trays so shape holds contents, but parts are 3D-printed in a user-chosen material and the configurator checks fit only, not waterproofing.
Dishwasher safety depends on material, heat resistance and food safety which the configurator does not check and cannot see.

finish.summary: Two-cell holder with two solid full-depth bins staged with spoon and fork. Waterproof/dishwasher-safe depend on user-chosen print material and are not verified.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
